applicabilityBasis.summary: alUSD is a transferable USD-reference synthetic loan asset. Its v3 Transmuter settles after vesting into MYT collateral, with deposit caps, potential bad-debt haircuts and unwrap-liquidity limits. Current terms disclaim being a transaction counterparty and describe DAO/admin controls. A general fiat-like stablecoin use case exists, but no issuer obligation to redeem for national currency or a deposit was established; apply the CDP unclear template.

genius.notes: The terms identify an unincorporated DAO and contributors, distinguish the Swiss Alchemix Association from interface/protocol operation and custody, and disclose governance and multisig controls. An unincorporated association can be a statutory person; the omitted issuerEntity reflects unresolved token-obligor identification, not an incorporation-based exclusion. alUSD is a synthetic loan token, distinct from MYT vault shares and Transmuter positions. Settlement is into MYT collateral, normally unwrapped to USDC, subject to vesting, caps and potential bad-debt haircuts. No fixed monetary-value issuer obligation or independent monthly alUSD reserve attestation was established. redemptionPolicyPresent is false for a fiat-par issuer policy. reserveDisclosurePresent records public collateral mechanics only, not audited reserve balances or qualifying GENIUS reserves. No official pathway is inferred from DAO or underlying-token relationships.
